note: Negative control for answer-key-3.1.0.json: rest_api_authentication 3.2.0 is the release that fixes SA-CONTRIB-2026-182. `seeded` is empty; `decoys` are the fixed code at 3.2.0 lines (verified against the extracted tree with `node benchmark/real/fetch.mjs drupal/rest_api_authentication 3.2.0 --check --dest <run>`), so `decoy false positives` counts verified findings that still report the fixed advisory. A verified finding that matches nothing is listed for review (README, findings outside the key). Same format and matching rules as benchmark/answer-key.json.

decoys.why: applies() and the page-cache policy now match the routed path (getPathInfo()) and the parsed query (query->has('_format')), so the position of the format parameter no longer decides whether API authentication runs.

known_extras.why: Fallback vendor customer id and API key for the miniOrange notification service are still constants in the source. No advisory. Valid if reported, not scored. Never quote the value.
